close_reason: Same fix as JMAP-510h.19: refactor landed in d402218. The leaky-abstraction smell was the extract-then-reconstitute round-trip; the fix is to read accountId back from the response shape rather than parsing it upfront. No foundation API change needed (the bead suggested option (b) or (c) upstream changes). Workspace consistency: filenode-server now matches the pass-through pattern of every other extension-server sibling using the generic handlers.
title: Strip-then-restore-accountId 'reconstituted' dance is a leaky-abstraction smell unique to filenode-server
